section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the concept of "Ein Od Milvado" is clarified in the maamar "Mayim Rabim" and in the teachings of the Rebbe Rashab, emphasizing that specifically in this lowly world the truth of G-d's exclusive reality is revealed.
section.t: And likewise it is explained in his “Mayim Rabim” [47]
regarding the concept of “Ein Od Milvado” [48]
[in addition to what is explained there [49]
regarding the concept of “HaGadol HaGibor…” [50]
(and our Sages, of blessed memory, said [51]
“HaGedulah” [52]
— this is Maaseh Bereishis)
as explained in Shaar HaYichud VeHaEmunah [53],
that this follows from what is explained there at the beginning of the discourse,
that even though the soul descends to a place where there are many waters and rivers that confuse,
nevertheless, “many waters cannot quench the love, nor rivers flood it away” [54],
behold, in addition to this it is explained there [55],
that even though the world is a reality,
nevertheless, its true essence is Elokus,
and specifically below this concept is seen,
as explained there at length.
And likewise it is explained in the maamarim of my revered father-in-law, the Rebbe
(the Rebbe Rashab)
of blessed memory [56],
that specifically below, in this world, it is seen and revealed how “there is no comparison to You”,
and through this we know that even the upper worlds are in the category of “no comparison” relative to the Atzmus.
And so it is also regarding the concept of “Ein Od Milvado”.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the true reality of the created being as the true reality—the Awtsmoos—applies specifically to the souls of Israel below, who are a veritable part of G-d.
section.t: Now, the true essence of the matter—that the created being, in its true reality, is the true reality,
His Essence,
applies to the souls of Israel as they are below,
for specifically regarding them can the attribute of “yesh” (existence) be said
(for they are in the category of existence),
unlike the nations of the world, etc., who are not in the category of existence [57],
for their entire essence is only that they are subsidiary to the souls of Israel [58]
(as explained in many places).
And when it is said that the created being is the true reality,
it applies to the souls of Israel below, whose root is in His Essence.
And even though all existents came into existence only from the truth of His existence
(and this is the foundation of foundations and the pillar of wisdoms, etc.) [59],
nevertheless,
the souls are literally a part of G-d from above [60],
and the teaching of the Baal Shem Tov is known [61],
that when you grasp a part of the essence, you grasp the whole of it.
And with this will also be understood that when the soul is below, behold, “a Jew does not want and cannot be separated from G-dliness, G-d forbid” [62],

for even as it exists below, in its true reality there is felt, so to speak, the true reality of His Essence and Being, whose existence is from His Essence and is not caused by any cause that preceded it, G-d forbid.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that Moshe Rabbeinu drew down the aspect of Atzmus into the soul below, enabling the soul's subsequent ascent, and that man's service below brings about a completion above.
section.t: And this is “And Moshe wrote their goings forth according to their journeys, and these are their journeys according to their goings forth,”
that Moshe Rabbeinu drew down the aspect of His Essence and Being
(“their goings forth”)
into the soul below
(“their journeys”),
and through this there was subsequently the ascent of the soul,
“and these are their journeys according to their goings forth.”
And as is explained at length in the maamar of the day of the hillula of Yud Shevat [63]
(and particularly in its twentieth chapter [64])
regarding the descent of the soul,
that because the soul descended very low,
into a body and an animal soul,
therefore,
in order for it to be able to withstand all the trials,
and fulfill its mission and task,
it specifically needs the attribute of Netzach (victory),
and the attribute of Netzach brings about the drawing down and revelation of the supernal treasure, which is the revelation of the pnimiyus and Atzmus of Ein Sof, blessed be He.
And moreover,
that through the service of man there is an elevation,
so to speak,
even above.
And it is known the teaching of the Maggid of Mezritch [65]
on the explanation of the Mishnah [66]
“Know what is above from you,”
meaning: know that everything that is above,
in the supernal Partzufim and Sefiros,
all is from you,
for it depends on the service of man.
And in more detail,
it is explained in his teaching [67]
on the verse [68]
“Make for yourself two silver trumpets”
[which was said to Moshe Rabbeinu, the faithful shepherd],
“trumpets” (chatzotzros) are two half-forms,
that through the service of man below, he effects a completion above, so to speak, that there will be a complete form.
